name: Sunken Temple: the Avatar of Hakkar never mind controls a tank and healer duo
contract: Vanilla 5-player dungeon bosses never sleep, charm or possess a player whose CoA specialization tanks or heals
(BossControlTargeting.h, AscensionBossControlRoles.cpp). The Avatar of Hakkar 8443 is the Sunken Temple (map 109,
expansion 0) encounter boss; its SmartAI casts Cause Insanity 12888 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM) at a random
non-top-threat hostile within 30 yd, first after 14-21 s of combat and then every 25-40 s. Vanguard 21 (Guardian)
tanks; Fleshweaver 25 (Bloodmage) and Grovekeeper 58 (Primalist) heal; Boltslinger 10 (Witch Hunter) deals
damage. The tank holds top threat with continuous melee; the others hit the Avatar briefly so they join its
threat list. With only a tank and a healer there is no eligible target, so Cause Insanity is never cast. The
players are level 54 humans, matching the boss, so its spells land at their normal hit chance. They group in
Stormwind and teleport into one instance, where the boss is summoned at its own stats; player health fixtures
keep everyone alive through the window. A control requires the boss to keep casting Lash 6607 through the same
window, so the 'never cast' result cannot come from an idle or broken AI.

steps.label: Let the characters finish logging in
healer joins tank's group
tank takes specialization 21
healer takes specialization 25
tank enters the dungeon
CONTROL: tank is inside the dungeon
healer enters the dungeon
CONTROL: healer is inside the dungeon
Summon the boss in the group's instance
The Avatar removes its unit flags 10 s out of combat (SmartAI event 2)
The tank engages first and keeps top threat
CONTROL: the Avatar is in combat
The tank builds a threat lead
healer joins the threat list
CONTROL: the tank holds the Avatar's attention, so Cause Insanity picks from the others
Run through the first cast window and at least one repeat
CONTROL: the Avatar is still fighting the group
CONTROL: the boss's AI keeps casting (Lash 6607)
The Avatar never casts Cause Insanity without a damage dealer to target
Cause Insanity never lands on the tank or the healer
